title: submission-meta/v1
description: The opn-submission block a service-opened pull request carries in its body (F07-R2), beside the opn-precheck-attestation block D-4's bounce rule reads. It declares who submitted, which of D-12's five artifacts this is, and the model and tooling D-23 requires disclosed; the authoritative attestation copies those forward. The block is not evidentiary — the gate re-derives every verdict — and a hand-opened pull request without one is gated exactly the same, with its tooling recorded undeclared (F07-R13).

submission_id.description: The service's id for this submission (ULID, as precheck job ids are)

pseudonym.description: What the ledger shows (D-19); the network stores no other name

proof_kind.description: How the identity was proven (D-19): a GitHub account, or a tutorial proof

artifact_type.description: D-12's five resolution artifacts; reduction is a partial with one hole (F07-Q1)

tooling.description: As declared by the submitter (D-23); never verified, never a gate input

precheck_job_id.description: The precheck job whose passing attestation this submission is bound to (F07-R1)
